description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports core React libraries, styles, and the root App component. It initializes the React DOM rendering process by attaching the React application to a DOM element with the ID 'root' and wraps the App component within React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
